result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on how many employees you have, whether you need to handle taxes and government remittances, and how much bookkeeping you want automated.

If you're operating a small business in **Canada**, I'd focus on software that handles\:

- CRA payroll deductions (income tax, CPP and EI).
- T4 and T4 Summary preparation.
- Payroll remittances and year-end reporting.
- Direct deposit.
- Vacation pay, overtime and statutory holiday calculations.
- Integration with your accounting software.

Here are the options I'd compare first.

## Best payroll software for Canadian small businesses

![Canada bank holidays and processing deadlines – Wagepoint](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/BeLrJTSa5EcYGruwCn3ZDIxMUlfcXvUOAWq-VkLCLOXdz1jzkCEyci0fWXdrXgftGn6W2rYz-lwC8Y0IoRwsfjD4UWeNALSFIPbehrCIgAbl20XbCFLJPYeU7ALSuo1T_gE3VKm0vx7ep4xL3fMx4B0KmoO2Sjhoyl0a8jBEmmu8q-IbjKKE4gQp0SBNRaHp?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Wagepoint**

(Best overall)

Best for small businesses with straightforward payroll

- Canadian-focused payroll.
- CPP, EI and tax calculations.
- Direct deposit, T4s and ROEs.
- CRA remittances.
- Relatively simple to operate.

Approximate starting price: \$20/month + \$4 per employee for one monthly payroll run.

[Wagepoint website](https://wagepoint.com/)

---

![Is QuickBooks Payroll Right For Your Small Business?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NxI61jHfD25H_nt8kRcYvHyRVuiwRzu6bQoayYIiX-p8_Tdm33tn9Kts01QntZfj3zQN9yJXydB71M2ZINU7Ryd1ra3_ou6nxuFmt_RR05RvmT9fmlWNmhedpXNBD2J0wX0aBNjOVffTjzvTAmAF2cn-1xTxGvSaxPrmNctmVLRRLezMTFbi5A9igGYQVZtF?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

Best if you already use QuickBooks

- Payroll and bookkeeping in one system.
- Automatic payroll calculations.
- Direct deposit.
- T4s and payroll reporting.
- Less manual bookkeeping.

Approximate starting price: \$30/month + \$5 per employee.

[QuickBooks Payroll website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/payroll/)

---

![Payworks - Made In Canada Directory](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JDMxoSeGQxMxiFL1WlmiX5yAKI9xRuaDUfQb6s6QcfAxTFJFbnN2kRi-gEYbnnOG4PrWAZTFpn3xs21LhDWxnQbK2WD_IFUqHaSdFe_RAXAGW3S0REiMzKGkkZ8KZy6JjkEu468uzREKIBJ8oxcvN3ufTsXg2JM7b6x4a2BhfAvpRoWj75NBPNUO2vBVAHLK?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Payworks**

(Best for personal support)

Best if you want more assistance managing payroll

- Canadian payroll provider.
- Direct deposit and tax remittances.
- Payroll reporting and year-end processing.
- HR and employee management options.
- More hands-on service.

Pricing by quote.

[Payworks website](https://www.payworks.ca/)

---

![AI for Employee Communications | ChangeEngine](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/M8WhEK_asl9rMLsgzwxIQWJzaRdb892_fAnYi8qmQNCv4nj5Z07uFbuHg6prUyIi0qjp0RHtjltbyv8l37F25o2fBFMepkSZ06J5CY6RedIcq1s0vALEvWk78UT3NNj7o4K8YZ_yP-Row6Is2UBPVs3UbSD3JVUoBbMlOmM0Z5cDAi5grUpv-x-LeQ52E6JE?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. ADP Canada**

Best for a growing business with more complex payroll

- Payroll automation.
- Tax calculations and filings.
- HR and employee management.
- Time tracking options.
- Scalable as your business grows.

Pricing by quote.

[ADP Canada website](https://www.adp.ca/)

Pricing is approximate, in Canadian dollars, and should be confirmed with each provider. Comparisons informed by 2026 reviews and pricing research. ## My recommendation

For a typical small business in British Columbia, I'd start by comparing **Wagepoint and QuickBooks Payroll**\.

- Choose Wagepoint if you want straightforward payroll without unnecessary extras.
- Choose QuickBooks if you want payroll integrated with your accounting.
